zh: 全场屏住呼吸，他站在罚球点前。
en: The whole ground holds its breath; he stands at the spot.

zh: 皮球越过人墙，直挂球门死角。
en: The ball clears the wall and flies into the corner.
What a beautiful strike!

zh: 他轻轻一拨，过掉了对手。
en: A light touch and he is past his opponent.

zh: 门将飞身扑救，还是没能碰到。
en: The keeper dives but cannot reach it.

zh: 球打在门柱上弹了进去。
en: It hits the post and bounces in.
The referee's whistle sounds.

zh: 队友们冲上来和他拥抱。
en: His teammates rush over to hug him.

zh: 他在空中超过了防守队员。
en: He rises above the defender in mid-air.

zh: 比赛中超过对手其实很难。
en: Getting past an opponent in a match is really hard.

zh: 多少年没见过这样的进球了！
en: How many years since we saw a goal like that!
The finest goal this year!
This is the move of the year.
Careful, he's about to go!

zh: 教练和老师都在场边看着。
en: The coach and the teacher watch from the side.

zh: 老板端着盘子走了过来。
en: The boss walks over with a plate.
It's easy to see he was ready.
He is very focused, not moving at all.
Don't blink, here comes the good bit!

zh: 皮球停在半空，时间仿佛静止。
en: The ball hangs in mid-air, as if time stopped.

zh: 千钧一发之际，他出脚了！
en: At the critical moment, he strikes!
What if it goes in? It really does!

zh: 他再三调整，终于站稳了。
en: He adjusts again and again, and finally steadies.
That was clean and neat.
He bursts away in an instant.
The ball goes straight into the net.

zh: 滑板在他脚下翻转了一圈。
en: The board flips once under his feet.

zh: 他稳稳落地，继续向前滑行。
en: He lands steadily and rolls on.
He has practised this move a long time.

zh: 街角的路人都停下了脚步。
en: Passers-by on the corner stop to watch.

zh: 他用力一蹬，滑板飞了起来。
en: A hard push and the board takes off.
The board comes back neatly under his feet.
The basketball traces an arc.

zh: 空心入网，一点都没碰到篮筐。
en: Nothing but net; it never touches the rim.
He jumps, shoots, it's in!

zh: 防守队员的手已经够不着了。
en: The defender's hand can no longer reach.

zh: 球在篮筐上转了又转，终于落下。
en: The ball circles the rim and finally drops.

zh: 他投篮的手感今天真好。
en: His shooting touch is really good today.
This shot comes at just the right moment.
The pancake turns over in the air.
It lands back in the pan!
He grips the handle and flicks his wrist.
Cheers fill the kitchen.
Golden crust, the aroma spreads.

zh: 这手翻饼的功夫真不错。
en: That flipping skill is really good.
No spatula needed, all by feel.
The bottle spins a few times in the air.
It actually stands upright!
The bottle on the table does not budge.

zh: 他轻轻一抛，屏住了呼吸。
en: He tosses it lightly and holds his breath.
That luck is simply incredible.

zh: 小狗一跃而起，稳稳接住了球。
en: The dog leaps and catches the ball.

zh: 它叼着球，得意地跑了回来。
en: It trots back proudly with the ball.

zh: 草地上，一只狗正在等待。
en: On the grass, a dog waits.

zh: 它的眼睛始终盯着那个球。
en: Its eyes never leave the ball.
Its tail will not stop wagging.
Patience. Then, movement.

zh: 在这片开阔地上，他静静等待。
en: On this open ground, he waits quietly.
The wind drops; all is quiet.

zh: 这是一个值得记住的瞬间。
en: This is a moment worth remembering.

zh: 他缓缓靠近，没有发出一点声音。
en: He edges closer without a sound.
Let us look once more.
Watch his feet.

zh: 慢镜头下，一切都清清楚楚。
en: In slow motion, everything is clear.

zh: 就在这里，皮球越过了门线。
en: Right here, the ball crosses the line.
Look at that turn again.

zh: 回放告诉我们，他的时机刚刚好。
en: The replay shows his timing was just right.
Here is the slow motion.

zh: 今晚头条，一次精彩出手。
en: Tonight's top story: a fine effort.

zh: 当时，他已经站在场地中央。
en: At that moment he was already in the centre of the pitch.
No one on the scene intervened.

zh: 据画面显示，动作已经完成。
en: The footage shows the action was complete.
That concludes this item.

zh: 此事引起了围观者的注意。
en: The matter drew the attention of onlookers.

zh: 他随即完成了这一动作。
en: He then completed the action.
The whole place erupts!
Unbelievable!
It's in!
Fantastic!
Simply brilliant!
That is pure quality!
A beautiful curve!
Perfect timing!
He did it!
Everyone is stunned.
You don't see scenes like this often.
His expression says it all.
The applause goes on and on.
He waves and walks back to the side.
Hats off to him!
A rare sight indeed.
That's what a master looks like.
Today belongs to him.
Chaos in front of goal.

zh: 皮球擦着横梁飞了出去。
en: The ball skims the bar and flies out.
So nearly in!

zh: 他的第一脚触球就很舒服。
en: His first touch is lovely.

zh: 这是他今天第二次尝试。
en: This is his second try today.

zh: 从四面八方传来欢呼声。
en: Cheers come from all sides.
Everything rests on this one go.
His steps are light and quick.
This jump is high and long.
He's done it!
The result was revealed at once.
This is pure muscle memory.
His pals all cheer.

zh: 这是今天比赛中年度最好的一脚。
en: In today's match, the best strike of the year.

zh: 他就像电影中超人一样飞了起来。
en: He flew like Superman in the film.

zh: 这一传让对方防线瘫痪了。
en: That pass left the other defence in disarray.

zh: 他四两拨千斤，轻松化解。
en: A light touch, and he deals with it easily.
A once-in-a-century goal.
That strike was perfect.
I believe in him one hundred percent.
His moves are ever-changing.

zh: 他三下五除二就解决了。
en: He sorted it out in no time.
That strike did two jobs at once.
So, so great!
So, so good!
So, so impressive!
So, so brilliant!
So, so beautiful!
So, so strong!
So, so fast!
